menu.title: Temporary Title
dialogue.intro_1: In your dreams an image appears of your family farm.
dialogue.intro_2: A familiar voice calls your name.
dialogue.intro_4: The memories of the past day flood your mind and you realize you have been sleeping in.
dialogue.intro_5: Your eyes spring open and you get out of bed
dialogue.intro_wake: You suddenly wake up and get out of bed.
dialogue.look_around_downstairs: What do you want to do?
dialogue.option.boots_by_door: Take your boots from by the door
dialogue.option.inspect_downstairs_chest: Inspect the chest by the door
dialogue.inspect_downstairs_chest: Your family stores hunting equipment in this chest.
dialogue.open_downstairs_chest: You open the chest and find your hunting sword.
dialogue.take_hunt_sword_2: 'I haven't used a sword in a while. I might be rusty.'
dialogue.leave_hunt_sword: I am not going hunting today.
dialogue.downstairs_chest_empty: You already took your hunting sword.
dialogue.check_by_door: You walk up to the door and look around.
dialogue.boots_by_door: You see your favorite pair of boots.
dialogue.take_boots: You take off your slippers and put your boots on.
dialogue.check_window: You approach the window and look outside
dialogue.window_react: 'The sky looks a bit grey tonight.'
dialogue.trapdoor: You open the trapdoor and look down...
dialogue.trapdoor_choice: Do you want to go down?
dialogue.option.trapdoor_step_away: Close the trapdoor and walk away
dialogue.trapdoor_walk_away: You close the trapdoor and turn around.
dialogue.trapdoor_fail_1: You start anxiously climbing down the ladder into the dark basement.
dialogue.trapdoor_fail_2: ... But upon reaching the ground you feel intense pain as a bright light surrounds you.
dialogue.trapdoor_pass_1: You recite the protection incantation and feel a gentle warmth surround you.
dialogue.trapdoor_pass_2: You confidently climb down to the basement, with the incantation illuminating your surroundings.
dialogue.look_around_upstairs: What do you want to do?
dialogue.bed_chest_1: You approach your chest at the foor of the bed.
dialogue.bed_chest_2: You open it and see your clothes neatly placed.
dialogue.bed_chest_3: You take out a white linen shirt, dark brown trowsers, belt and stockings.
dialogue.bed_chest_4: You dress yourself and reach back into your chest.
dialogue.bed_chest_5: You take out your bag and fasten it with your belt.
dialogue.sleep_1: You get in bed and fall asleep.
dialogue.sleep_2: Your dream gets interrupted by a strange sensation.
dialogue.no_inventory: 'I should get dressed before I mess with things.'
dialogue.tome_read_1: You open it up and notice many of the pages are missing.
dialogue.tome_read_2: There is a loose page with a passage labeled 'Fire Protection Incantation'.
dialogue.tome_unlock_incant: You read the incantation and its knowledge leaves an imprint in your mind.
dialogue.tome_close: You close the book and step away.
dialogue.right_bookshelf: You find a book titled 'Forbidden Knowledge'.
dialogue.right_bookshelf_empty: You already took the book on this shelf.
dialogue.forbidden_react: How exciting! I wonder what secrets this contains...
dialogue.option.forbidden_dont_read: Take the book but don't read it.
dialogue.forbidden_open: You open the book and read the foreword.
dialogue.forbidden_read_1: In red letters it is written: He who readeth this booke shall die.
dialogue.leave_door: You open the door and step outside.
dialogue.door_encounter: Stepping outside, you hear screaming and suddenly turn to your left
dialogue.door_death_1: You are suddenly impaled by a spear in your chest.
dialogue.door_death_2: You feel a sharp pain. You were shot by an arrow in your chest.
dialogue.door_death_3: You fall over suddenly as your leg is severed.
dialogue.door_death_4: You let out a scream as a sharp pain fills your mind.
dialogue.collapse_floor: You collapse on the floor and your vision fades.
dialogue.collapse_floor_book: You feel an intense pain and collapse to the floor.
dialogue.table: You check your table for anything useful.
dialogue.table_2: Among the things on the table, you find a warm loaf of bread.
dialogue.table_empty: There is nothing useful left on the table.
dialogue.inspect_table: What do you want to do?
dialogue.basement_1: You have safely descended to the basement.
dialogue.look_around_basement: What do you want to do?
